name: ACE OF SPADES
source: Enter a secret, members only casino. Nobody bets in money here: dealers and players alike have their own sex-slaves and the loser's will get punished for her master's lack of skill. The masters can even lose their slaves, if they lose enough matches. You can try your luck either in blackjack or in poker.
translation: 进入这家只对会员开放的秘密赌场。这里不以金钱下注：庄家和玩家各自带着性奴，输家会因主人技术不佳而受到惩罚。主人输掉足够多的对局，甚至可能连奴隶也一并失去。你可以在二十一点或扑克中试试运气。
